game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ash bricks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 1; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 6: {'n': -1}; {'n': 4}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the fire shrine using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 16.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the fire shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
